posts.trend: "This Is Hell": Bengaluru Man Raises Traffic Concerns Over Nearly 2-Hour Office Commute
posts.context: Tech companies have forced employees back to the office, converting leisure hours into brutal traffic time.
posts.angle: The commute is the actual job; the office work is just a desk-bound distraction.
